records.title: A systematic review of meta-cognitive approaches to AGI
records.reason: Systematic review concerns metacognitive approaches to AGI and does not specify a concrete LLM inference efficiency technique or relevant existing paper lineage.

records.title: Bridging the Deployment Gap: A Decision Oriented Survey of Efficient On-Device Foundation Models for Vision
records.reason: Survey is explicitly about efficient on-device vision foundation models; no language-model inference method or lineage is indicated.

records.title: CHoE: Cross-Domain Heterogeneous Graph Prompt Learning via Structure-Conditioned Experts
records.reason: Graph prompt learning and structure-conditioned experts address heterogeneous graph tasks, not LLM serving or inference efficiency.

records.title: Reshape and Recur: Improving SSMs with Input Reshaping and Depth Recurrence
records.reason: Primary arXiv HTML, sections 1, 3–5: depth recurrence and input reshaping for SSMs are evaluated on time-series classification datasets; parameter-shared depth variants use up to 1/L parameters and input reshaping adds 1–6% accuracy. The paper notes SSM efficiency motivation but evaluates time-series classifiers, not language-model inference, and supplies no LLM serving/latency result. Transfer to language SSM architecture is plausible but unestablished.

records.title: Large Language Model Fine-Tuning via Layer Importance Analysis Based on Extreme Values
records.reason: Layer-importance analysis is for LLM fine-tuning cost/parameter efficiency; abstract gives no inference-time compute, memory, latency, KV-cache, quantization, offload, or serving improvement.
